full_judgment: 2. Short facts leading to this appeal are that on 28-8-1969, the respondent Nos. 1-2 as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 108 of 1969, in the Court of Munsif, Nilphamari, imp leading the appellants and respondent Nos. 3-4 as defendants for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession and also for declaration that the kabala deed No. 5430 dated 3-7-1969 executed by defendant Nos. 3-4 in favour of defendant Nos. 1-2 in respect of 0.45 acres of land out of 1.48 acres described in the schedule-'A' of the plaint is illegal, fraudulent, void and not binding upon them and cancellation of the deed.
